'''''Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth''''' is a novel tie-in to [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] television series. It was written by [[Karen Miller]] and was released on [[February 23]], [[2010]]. The audio version is narrated by [[Jeff Gurner]].
